definitions.explanation: Replacing existing data or content by writing new data in its place. Most commonly used in computing contexts.

definitions.gloss: address written on the outside of a letter
definitions.explanation: The name and address written on the outside of an envelope or package. A traditional usage.

examples.japanese: ⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{上書|うわが}き⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To save a file by overwriting it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧{上書|うわが}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{上書|うわが}き⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful not to overwrite important data.

examples.japanese: ⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上書|うわが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the address on the envelope.

notes:
{上書|うわが}き has two meanings: overwriting data (computing) and the address on an envelope (traditional). The computing sense is far more common today.

COMPUTING USAGE:
- {上書|うわが}き⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: Save (overwrite existing file) — equivalent to Ctrl+S
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: Save As — saves as a new file
- {上書|うわが}き⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: write-protected, overwrite not allowed

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {上書|うわが}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to overwrite
- {上書|うわが}き⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be overwritten
- ⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧{上書|うわが}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accidentally overwrite

TRADITIONAL USAGE:
In letter-writing, {上書|うわが}き refers to the name and address written on the outside of an envelope (⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧). This usage is now less common but still appears in formal contexts.

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ (on top) + ⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (writing) — writing on top of something.
